# Build-time Markdown renderer

`marked.mjs` is the ESM build of [Marked 18.0.13](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/releases/tag/v18.0.13), retrieved from its official npm distribution and verified against the package SHA-512 integrity value. It is used only during the static build; the browser does not load it. The MIT license is retained in `MARKED-LICENSE.md`.
